description: Calibrated simulation null: is the VAM10-frame dN/dS lower than expected from VPS5 coding constraint alone?
code:
import requests, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, itertools as it
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
EU="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
GENES={"S. cerevisiae":"854235","S. paradoxus":"54633636","S. mikatae":"80921287",
       "S. kudriavzevii":"80927111","S. eubayanus":"28934048"}
sm=S.get(EU+"esummary.fcgi",params=dict(db="gene",id=",".join(GENES.values()),retmode="json"),timeout=90).json()["result"]
def ef(acc,s,e,st):
    for _ in range(5):
        t=S.get(EU+"efetch.fcgi",params=dict(db="nuccore",id=acc,rettype="fasta",retmode="text",
                seq_start=s,seq_stop=e,strand=st),timeout=120).text
        q="".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
        if len(q)>500: return q
        time.sleep(2)
    return ""
CDS={}
for nm,gid in GENES.items():
    L=sm[gid]["genomicinfo"][0]; a,b=int(L["chrstart"]),int(L["chrstop"])
    s,e,st=(a+1,b+1,1) if a<=b else (b+1,a+1,2)
    CDS[nm]=ef(L["chraccver"],s,e,st); time.sleep(0.4)
bases="TCAG";aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={};i=0
for b1 in bases:
    for b2 in bases:
        for b3 in bases:
            CODON[b1+b2+b3]=aas[i];i+=1
SYN={}
for c,a in CODON.items(): SYN.setdefault(a,[]).append(c)
tr=lambda s:"".join(CODON.get(s[k:k+3],"X") for k in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
COMP=str.maketrans("ACGT-","TGCA-"); rc=lambda s:s.translate(COMP)[::-1]
NT="TCAG"
def syn_sites(c):
    if "-" in c or CODON.get(c) in (None,"*"): return None
    return sum(sum(1 for b in NT if b!=c[p] and CODON[c[:p]+b+c[p+1:]]==CODON[c])/3.0 for p in range(3))
def pathways(c1,c2):
    diffs=[k for k in range(3) if c1[k]!=c2[k]]
    if not diffs: return 0.,0.
    ts=tn=0.;np_=0
    for perm in it.permutations(diffs):
        cur=c1;s=n=0;ok=True
        for k in perm:
            nxt=cur[:k]+c2[k]+cur[k+1:]
            if CODON[nxt]=="*": ok=False;break
            if CODON[nxt]==CODON[cur]: s+=1
            else: n+=1
            cur=nxt
        if ok: ts+=s;tn+=n;np_+=1
    return (ts/np_,tn/np_) if np_ else (0.,float(len(diffs)))
jc=lambda p: float("nan") if (p is None or p>=0.749) else -0.75*np.log(1-4*p/3)
def ng(seq1,seq2,frame=0):
    SS=NN=SD=ND=0.0
    for k in range(frame,min(len(seq1),len(seq2))-2,3):
        c1,c2=seq1[k:k+3],seq2[k:k+3]
        s1,s2=syn_sites(c1),syn_sites(c2)
        if s1 is None or s2 is None: continue
        Sx=(s1+s2)/2.; SS+=Sx; NN+=3-Sx
        sd,nd=pathways(c1,c2); SD+=sd; ND+=nd
    return SD/SS, ND/NN, SS, NN

# --- extract the VAM10-overlapping codon block (S.cer VPS5 codons 34-149) and its ortholog block ---
# ungapped assumption verified earlier (no gaps inside the window for these species)
VAM10="MLFEVFGEVLASYIVSSKTKGELAFPVNNAPPDSLVAINCVVLFLRSAIGSCSGAKELIRSSALELSCSSSCGLPATDKPGSFHSGALSKSILSANEAVVSKSSLSFLSSFVDI"
ref="S. cerevisiae"
a_ref=CDS[ref][99:447]   # codons 34..149 of VPS5 (0-based nt 99..446)
rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
results=[]
for sp in ["S. paradoxus","S. mikatae","S. kudriavzevii","S. eubayanus"]:
    # locate the orthologous block by best ungapped offset of the VPS5 protein N-terminal region
    p0=tr(CDS[ref]).rstrip("*"); p1=tr(CDS[sp]).rstrip("*")
    best=(-1,0)
    for off in range(-6,7):
        a=p0[33:149]; st=33+off
        if st<0 or st+116>len(p1): continue
        b=p1[st:st+116]
        sc=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x==y)
        if sc>best[0]: best=(sc,off)
    off=best[1]; a_sp=CDS[sp][3*(33+off):3*(33+off)+348]
    # observed
    pS_v,pN_v,_,_ = ng(a_ref,a_sp,0)                       # VPS5 frame, overlap block
    ra,rb = rc(a_ref), rc(a_sp)
    fr=[f for f in range(3) if tr(ra[f:]).startswith(VAM10[:15])]
    f=fr[0] if fr else 0
    pS_a,pN_a,_,_ = ng(ra,rb,f)                            # VAM10 frame
    obs_dnds = jc(pN_a)/jc(pS_a)
    # --- calibrated null: randomise synonymous codon choice in the ortholog, preserving both proteins ---
    aa_sp=[CODON[a_sp[k:k+3]] for k in range(0,348,3)]
    def simulate(r):
        out=[]
        for k,aa in enumerate(aa_sp):
            c=a_sp[3*k:3*k+3]
            if aa=="*" or rng.random()>r: out.append(c)
            else: out.append(SYN[aa][rng.integers(len(SYN[aa]))])
        return "".join(out)
    # tune r so simulated VPS5-frame pS matches observed
    grid=np.linspace(0,1,11); errs=[]
    for r in grid:
        v=np.mean([ng(a_ref,simulate(r),0)[0] for _ in range(6)])
        errs.append(abs(v-pS_v))
    r_opt=float(grid[int(np.argmin(errs))])
    null=[]
    for _ in range(200):
        sim=simulate(r_opt)
        s,n,_,_=ng(a_ref,sim,0)
        rs,rn,_,_=ng(rc(a_ref),rc(sim),f)
        dS,dN=jc(rs),jc(rn)
        if dS and dS==dS and dS>0: null.append(dN/dS)
    null=np.array(null)
    p_emp=float((null<=obs_dnds).mean())
    results.append(dict(species=sp, offset=off, obs_VAM10_dNdS=round(obs_dnds,3),
                        null_median=round(float(np.median(null)),3),
                        null_2p5=round(float(np.percentile(null,2.5)),3),
                        null_97p5=round(float(np.percentile(null,97.5)),3),
                        r_opt=r_opt, p_one_sided=round(p_emp,3), n_null=len(null)))
    print(results[-1])
df=pd.DataFrame(results); pd.set_option("display.width",250)
print(); print(df.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
x=np.arange(len(df))
ax.errorbar(x, df.null_median, yerr=[df.null_median-df.null_2p5, df.null_97p5-df.null_median],
            fmt="o", color="#64748b", capsize=5, label="null: VPS5 constraint only (95% range, n=200 sims)")
ax.plot(x, df.obs_VAM10_dNdS, "D", color="#c2410c", ms=9, label="observed VAM10-frame dN/dS")
ax.axhline(1.0, ls=":", c="k", lw=1)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(df.species, rotation=15)
ax.set_ylabel("dN/dS in the VAM10 reading frame")
ax.set_title("VAM10-frame dN/dS is not lower than expected from VPS5 constraint alone")
ax.legend(fontsize=9, frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
